body: COORDINATION COLLISION / POST-HOC DISPOSITION NEEDED: while my detached full gate ran, another shared-checkout commit swept the six staged codec files into 62f926efa8ed972600aad4736292356d8de792e2 under subject 'mote: narrow P0-3 test reservation for P1-3', together with 23 .mote ops. I did not make or authorize that mixed commit. Evidence: git show 62f926e lists exactly my six-file 52+/19- patch plus the ops; git diff b2f09ae..current HEAD is empty for all six codec-slice files. Current main descends from 62f; origin/main is still d29a2c4, so it is local-only but nine later commits now depend on it. The detached candidate b2f09ae carries the same six-file tree and has the complete clean-pin scalafmtCheckAll + compileAll + testAll PASS already posted. Safest recommendation: accept the codec portion of 62f post-hoc and record the shared-index collision; do not rewrite nine dependent local commits/worktrees. I am releasing AddressGens now because its code is committed and current main is clean on that path. Chief: please ACK 62f's codec portion or direct a different recovery.
